newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Teljoy sees better earnings in year ahead.
newsitem.headline: Teljoy sees better earnings in year ahead.

text.p: South African mobile phone to television rental firm Teljoy Ltd said on Monday it was confident of a substantial improvement in 1998 earnings.
"In short, our essential business is in a phase of rapid growth," chairman Peet van der Walt said in the company's annual report.
In May the firm posted a a pre-exceptional year earnings per share of 9.5 cents, against a 58.7 cents loss in the previous year.
Chief executive Johann Peiterse predicted the group would stay in the black.

"We expect that both the cellular and television divisions will generate meaningful profits and the group earnings before exceptional items will increase substantially from the current base," he said.
